# netactuate_bgp_group_firewall_set (Resource)

Binds a firewall set to a BGP group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_bgp_group_firewall_set" "example" {
  bgp_group_id    = 12345
  firewall_set_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bgp_group_id` (Number) BGP group ID to bind the firewall set to.
- `firewall_set_id` (Number) Firewall set ID to bind to the BGP group.

### Optional

- `interface_number` (Number) BGP group interface number for the firewall binding.
- `set_priority` (Number) Priority of this firewall set binding.

### Read-Only

- `binding_id` (Number) API assigned firewall set binding ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_bgp_group_firewall_set.example 12345
```
